ko.title: 한 도시에 40대의 드론: UN이 대량 학살의 경고 신호라고 부르는 포위전의 내부 상황

segments.src: ## A City Under Near-Daily Bombardment
segments.tr: ## 거의 매일 이어지는 폭격 하의 도시

segments.src: For months, residents of el-Obeid, the capital of Sudan's North Kordofan state, have described a grim daily routine: the distant buzz of drones overhead, followed by the wait to see where the next strike will land.
segments.tr: 수개월 동안 수단 북코르도판 주의 주도인 엘오베이드의 주민들은 참혹한 일상을 묘사해 왔습니다. 머리 위로 드론의 윙윙거리는 소리가 멀리서 들려오고, 이어 다음 공격이 어디에 떨어질지 기다리는 일입니다.

segments.src: Humanitarian monitors tracking the conflict say the city has absorbed dozens of drone attacks in a matter of weeks — by some counts, roughly forty strikes have hit the area — as fighting between Sudan's army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) grinds through its third year.
segments.tr: 분쟁을 추적하는 인도주의적 감시단은 수단 정부군과 준군사 조직인 신속지원군(RSF) 간의 전투가 3년 차에 접어들면서, 불과 몇 주 만에 이 도시가 수십 차례의 드론 공격을 받았다고 말합니다. 일부 집계에 따르면 이 지역에 약 40차례의 공격이 가해졌습니다.

segments.src: El-Obeid sits at a strategic crossroads linking Khartoum to Sudan's western regions, which is part of why it has become a flashpoint.
segments.tr: 엘오베이드는 하르툼과 수단의 서부 지역을 잇는 전략적 교차로에 위치해 있으며, 이것이 이 도시가 분쟁의 중심지가 된 이유 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: Aid workers say the city has effectively been under siege, with supply routes choked off and civilians caught between advancing front lines.
segments.tr: 구호 활동가들은 이 도시가 사실상 포위 상태에 있으며, 보급로가 차단되고 민간인들이 전진하는 전선 사이에 갇혔다고 말합니다.

segments.src: ## Hospitals Knocked Out of Service
segments.tr: ## 병원 서비스 중단

segments.src: Among the most alarming consequences, according to humanitarian organizations operating in the area, is the damage inflicted on el-Obeid's already-strained health system.
segments.tr: 해당 지역에서 활동하는 인도주의 단체들에 따르면, 가장 우려스러운 결과 중 하나는 이미 한계에 다다른 엘오베이드의 보건 의료 시스템에 가해진 피해입니다.

segments.src: Strikes attributed to the ongoing fighting have reportedly hit or forced the closure of medical facilities, stripping the city of capacity just as civilian casualties and disease outbreaks are rising.
segments.tr: 지속되는 전투로 인한 공격이 의료 시설을 타격하거나 폐쇄하도록 강요했다는 보고가 있으며, 이는 민간인 사상자와 질병 발생이 증가하는 시점에 도시의 의료 역량을 앗아갔습니다.

segments.src: The World Health Organization and Sudanese medical unions have repeatedly warned that attacks on hospitals violate international humanitarian law, regardless of which side is responsible, and that a functioning health system is often the difference between a contained outbreak and a public health catastrophe.
segments.tr: 세계보건기구(WHO)와 수단 의료 노동조합은 어느 쪽의 책임인지와 관계없이 병원에 대한 공격이 국제 인도법을 위반하는 것이며, 제대로 작동하는 보건 시스템이 전염병의 확산을 막느냐 아니면 공중 보건의 대재앙으로 이어지느냐를 결정짓는 경우가 많다고 반복해서 경고해 왔습니다.

segments.src: With fuel, medicine and staff in short supply, doctors on the ground say they are being forced to make impossible choices about who receives treatment — a situation aid groups describe as unsustainable if the bombardment continues at its current pace.
segments.tr: 연료, 의약품 및 인력이 부족한 상황에서 현장 의사들은 누구에게 치료를 제공할지에 대해 불가능한 선택을 강요받고 있다고 말합니다. 구호 단체들은 폭격이 현재의 속도로 계속된다면 이러한 상황은 지속 불가능하다고 설명합니다.

segments.src: ## Cholera Spreads as Water Systems Fail
segments.tr: ## 상수도 시스템 붕괴로 인한 콜레라 확산

segments.src: Compounding the crisis, health officials have confirmed a spreading cholera outbreak in and around el-Obeid.
segments.tr: 위기에 더해, 보건 당국은 엘오베이드와 그 주변 지역에서 콜레라가 확산되고 있음을 확인했습니다.

segments.src: Cholera thrives where clean water and sanitation infrastructure has broken down — conditions that sieges and displacement reliably produce.
segments.tr: 콜레라는 깨끗한 물과 위생 인프라가 붕괴된 곳에서 번성하며, 이는 포위전과 강제 이주가 필연적으로 만들어내는 조건입니다.

segments.src: Aid agencies report that damaged water systems, overcrowded displacement sites, and the collapse of routine health services have created ideal conditions for the waterborne disease to take hold.
segments.tr: 구호 기관들은 파손된 상수도 시스템, 과밀한 이주민 수용소, 그리고 일상적인 보건 서비스의 붕괴가 수인성 질병이 자리 잡기에 이상적인 조건을 만들었다고 보고합니다.

segments.src: Sudan has recorded cholera cases in multiple states since the civil war reignited in 2023, but responders say the situation in North Kordofan is especially difficult to manage because access for aid convoys remains severely restricted, limiting the delivery of oral rehydration supplies, chlorine tablets and vaccines.
segments.tr: 수단은 2023년 내전이 재점화된 이후 여러 주에서 콜레라 사례를 기록했지만, 구호 요원들은 구호 호송대의 접근이 심하게 제한되어 경구 수액 보충제, 염소 정제 및 백신 전달이 제한적이기 때문에 북코르도판의 상황이 특히 관리하기 어렵다고 말합니다.

segments.src: ## The UN's Warning: A Pattern That Precedes Atrocities
segments.tr: ## UN의 경고: 학살에 앞서는 패턴

segments.src: United Nations officials monitoring Sudan have pointed to el-Obeid as an example of a broader and deeply concerning pattern: repeated strikes on civilian infrastructure, blocked humanitarian access, and the targeting of essential services in besieged areas.
segments.tr: 수단을 감시하는 유엔 관계자들은 엘오베이드를 더 넓고 깊이 우려되는 패턴의 예로 꼽았습니다. 즉, 민간인 인프라에 대한 반복적인 공격, 인도주의적 접근 차단, 그리고 포위된 지역의 필수 서비스 타격입니다.

segments.src: UN representatives have cautioned that this combination of tactics — documented elsewhere in Sudan's war, including in Darfur — has historically preceded some of the gravest violations of international law, and they have urged both the Sudanese Armed Forces and the RSF to allow unimpeded humanitarian access and to protect civilians and medical facilities under international humanitarian law.
segments.tr: 유엔 대표들은 다르푸르를 포함해 수단 전쟁의 다른 곳에서도 기록된 이러한 전술의 조합이 역사적으로 국제법의 가장 심각한 위반 사례들보다 앞서 나타났다고 경고하며, 수단 정부군과 RSF 모두에게 방해 없는 인도주의적 접근을 허용하고 국제 인도법에 따라 민간인과 의료 시설을 보호할 것을 촉구했습니다.

segments.src: Human rights researchers note that sieges which cut off food, water, fuel and medicine can constitute collective punishment of civilian populations, a serious violation regardless of the military objectives claimed by the parties involved.
segments.tr: 인권 연구원들은 식량, 물, 연료 및 의약품을 차단하는 포위전이 민간인 인구에 대한 집단적 처벌이 될 수 있으며, 이는 관련 당사자들이 주장하는 군사적 목적과 관계없이 심각한 위반이라고 지적합니다.

segments.src: The UN has called for independent investigations into strikes on hospitals and for accountability mechanisms to be strengthened as the conflict continues.
segments.tr: 유엔은 병원에 대한 공격에 대한 독립적인 조사를 요청하고, 분쟁이 계속됨에 따라 책임 추궁 메커니즘을 강화할 것을 촉구했습니다.

segments.src: ## A Wider Humanitarian Emergency
segments.tr: ## 더 넓은 인도주의적 비상사태

segments.src: Sudan's civil war has already produced one of the world's largest displacement crises, with the UN estimating that millions of people have fled their homes since fighting began in April 2023.
segments.tr: 수단의 내전은 이미 세계 최대의 강제 이주 위기 중 하나를 초래했으며, 유엔은 2023년 4월 전투가 시작된 이후 수백만 명의 사람들이 집을 떠났다고 추정합니다.

segments.src: El-Obeid's situation reflects a broader trend across contested areas of the country, where famine conditions, disease outbreaks and attacks on civilian infrastructure have converged.
segments.tr: 엘오베이드의 상황은 기근 조건, 질병 발생 및 민간인 인프라에 대한 공격이 겹친 국가 내 분쟁 지역 전반의 더 넓은 추세를 반영합니다.

segments.src: International aid organizations have appealed for expanded humanitarian corridors and increased funding, warning that without a sustained ceasefire and guaranteed access for relief workers, cities like el-Obeid risk becoming case studies in how modern sieges can escalate into humanitarian catastrophes.
segments.tr: 국제 구호 단체들은 인도주의적 통로를 확대하고 자금 지원을 늘릴 것을 호소하며, 지속적인 휴전과 구호 요원들의 보장된 접근권이 없다면 엘오베이드와 같은 도시들이 현대의 포위전이 어떻게 인도주의적 대재앙으로 확대될 수 있는지를 보여주는 사례 연구가 될 위험이 있다고 경고했습니다.

segments.src: For now, residents say they are left to weather both the drones overhead and the disease spreading in the shadows below — waiting for a diplomatic breakthrough that, so far, has remained out of reach.
segments.tr: 현재로서는 주민들이 머리 위로 날아다니는 드론과 그 아래 그림자 속에서 퍼지는 질병을 모두 견뎌내야 한다고 말하며, 지금까지는 닿지 않는 외교적 돌파구를 기다리고 있습니다.

zh.title: 一座城市上空的四十架无人机：联合国称之为大规模暴行的预警信号的围城内幕

segments.src: ## A City Under Near-Daily Bombardment
segments.tr: ## 一座处于近乎每日轰炸下的城市

segments.src: For months, residents of el-Obeid, the capital of Sudan's North Kordofan state, have described a grim daily routine: the distant buzz of drones overhead, followed by the wait to see where the next strike will land.
segments.tr: 数月来，苏丹北科尔多凡州首府奥贝德的居民描述了一种阴森的日常生活：头顶上远处传来的无人机嗡嗡声，随后是等待下一次打击将落在哪里。

segments.src: Humanitarian monitors tracking the conflict say the city has absorbed dozens of drone attacks in a matter of weeks — by some counts, roughly forty strikes have hit the area — as fighting between Sudan's army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) grinds through its third year.
segments.tr: 追踪冲突的人道主义监测人员表示，在苏丹军队与准军事组织快速支援部队 (RSF) 的战斗进入第三年之际，这座城市在短短几周内遭受了数十次无人机袭击——据某些统计，该地区大约遭受了四十次打击。

segments.src: El-Obeid sits at a strategic crossroads linking Khartoum to Sudan's western regions, which is part of why it has become a flashpoint.
segments.tr: 奥贝德位于连接喀土穆与苏丹西部地区的战略十字路口，这也是它成为冲突爆发点的原因之一。

segments.src: Aid workers say the city has effectively been under siege, with supply routes choked off and civilians caught between advancing front lines.
segments.tr: 援助人员表示，这座城市实际上处于被围困状态，供应路线被切断，平民被困在推进的前线之间。

segments.src: ## Hospitals Knocked Out of Service
segments.tr: ## 医院失去服务能力

segments.src: Among the most alarming consequences, according to humanitarian organizations operating in the area, is the damage inflicted on el-Obeid's already-strained health system.
segments.tr: 根据在该地区运作的人道主义组织，最令人担忧的后果之一是奥贝德本已紧张的医疗系统遭受的破坏。

segments.src: Strikes attributed to the ongoing fighting have reportedly hit or forced the closure of medical facilities, stripping the city of capacity just as civilian casualties and disease outbreaks are rising.
segments.tr: 据报道，归因于持续战斗的袭击击中了或迫使医疗设施关闭，就在平民伤亡和疾病爆发增加之时，剥夺了这座城市的医疗能力。

segments.src: The World Health Organization and Sudanese medical unions have repeatedly warned that attacks on hospitals violate international humanitarian law, regardless of which side is responsible, and that a functioning health system is often the difference between a contained outbreak and a public health catastrophe.
segments.tr: 世界卫生组织和苏丹医疗工会多次警告说，无论哪一方负责，袭击医院都违反了国际人道法，而且一个运作良好的医疗系统通常是控制疫情与公共卫生灾难之间的区别。

segments.src: With fuel, medicine and staff in short supply, doctors on the ground say they are being forced to make impossible choices about who receives treatment — a situation aid groups describe as unsustainable if the bombardment continues at its current pace.
segments.tr: 由于燃料、药品和人员短缺，前线的医生表示，他们被迫在谁能接受治疗方面做出不可能的选择——援助团体将这种情况描述为如果轰炸按当前速度继续，将是不可持续的。

segments.src: ## Cholera Spreads as Water Systems Fail
segments.tr: ## 水系统失效导致霍乱传播

segments.src: Compounding the crisis, health officials have confirmed a spreading cholera outbreak in and around el-Obeid.
segments.tr: 使危机加剧的是，卫生官员确认了奥贝德及其周边地区霍乱的传播。

segments.src: Cholera thrives where clean water and sanitation infrastructure has broken down — conditions that sieges and displacement reliably produce.
segments.tr: 霍乱在清洁水和卫生基础设施崩溃的地方滋生——围城和流离失所可靠地产生了这种情况。

segments.src: Aid agencies report that damaged water systems, overcrowded displacement sites, and the collapse of routine health services have created ideal conditions for the waterborne disease to take hold.
segments.tr: 援助机构报告称，受损的水系统、过度拥挤的流离失所点以及常规医疗服务的崩溃，为这种水传疾病的肆虐创造了理想条件。

segments.src: Sudan has recorded cholera cases in multiple states since the civil war reignited in 2023, but responders say the situation in North Kordofan is especially difficult to manage because access for aid convoys remains severely restricted, limiting the delivery of oral rehydration supplies, chlorine tablets and vaccines.
segments.tr: 自 2023 年内战重启以来，苏丹在多个州记录了霍乱病例，但救援人员表示，北科尔多凡的情况尤其难以管理，因为援助车队的进入仍然受到严重限制，限制了口服补液盐、氯片和疫苗的交付。

segments.src: ## The UN's Warning: A Pattern That Precedes Atrocities
segments.tr: ## 联合国的警告：暴行之前的模式

segments.src: United Nations officials monitoring Sudan have pointed to el-Obeid as an example of a broader and deeply concerning pattern: repeated strikes on civilian infrastructure, blocked humanitarian access, and the targeting of essential services in besieged areas.
segments.tr: 监测苏丹的联合国官员指出，奥贝德是一个更广泛且令人深感担忧的模式的例子：重复袭击平民基础设施、封锁人道主义通道以及针对被围困地区的基本服务。

segments.src: UN representatives have cautioned that this combination of tactics — documented elsewhere in Sudan's war, including in Darfur — has historically preceded some of the gravest violations of international law, and they have urged both the Sudanese Armed Forces and the RSF to allow unimpeded humanitarian access and to protect civilians and medical facilities under international humanitarian law.
segments.tr: 联合国代表警告说，这种战术组合——在苏丹战争的其他地方（包括达尔富尔）也有记录——在历史上往往发生在一些最严重的国际法违规行为之前，他们敦促苏丹武装部队和 RSF 允许不受阻碍的人道主义进入，并根据国际人道法保护平民和医疗设施。

segments.src: Human rights researchers note that sieges which cut off food, water, fuel and medicine can constitute collective punishment of civilian populations, a serious violation regardless of the military objectives claimed by the parties involved.
segments.tr: 人权研究人员指出，切断食物、水、燃料和药品的围城可能构成对平民人口的集体惩罚，无论相关方主张的军事目标如何，这都是严重的违规。

segments.src: The UN has called for independent investigations into strikes on hospitals and for accountability mechanisms to be strengthened as the conflict continues.
segments.tr: 联合国呼吁对袭击医院的行为进行独立调查，并在冲突继续期间加强问责机制。

segments.src: ## A Wider Humanitarian Emergency
segments.tr: ## 更广泛的人道主义紧急情况

segments.src: Sudan's civil war has already produced one of the world's largest displacement crises, with the UN estimating that millions of people have fled their homes since fighting began in April 2023.
segments.tr: 苏丹内战已经造成了全球最大的流离失所危机之一，联合国估计自 2023 年 4 月战斗开始以来，已有数百万人逃离家园。

segments.src: El-Obeid's situation reflects a broader trend across contested areas of the country, where famine conditions, disease outbreaks and attacks on civilian infrastructure have converged.
segments.tr: 奥贝德的情况反映了该国冲突地区的一个更广泛趋势，即饥荒状况、疾病爆发和对平民基础设施的袭击交织在一起。

segments.src: International aid organizations have appealed for expanded humanitarian corridors and increased funding, warning that without a sustained ceasefire and guaranteed access for relief workers, cities like el-Obeid risk becoming case studies in how modern sieges can escalate into humanitarian catastrophes.
segments.tr: 国际援助组织呼吁扩大人道主义走廊并增加资金，警告说如果没有持续的停火和对救援人员的保障进入，像奥贝德这样的城市有风险成为现代围城如何升级为人道主义灾难的案例研究。

segments.src: For now, residents say they are left to weather both the drones overhead and the disease spreading in the shadows below — waiting for a diplomatic breakthrough that, so far, has remained out of reach.
segments.tr: 目前，居民们表示他们只能忍受头顶上的无人机和在阴影中传播的疾病——等待着一个到目前为止仍然遥不可及的外交突破。

hi.title: एक शहर पर चालीस ड्रोन: उस घेराबंदी के अंदर जिसे संयुक्त राष्ट्र ने सामूहिक {Atrocities} के चेतावनी संकेत के रूप में कहा है

segments.src: ## A City Under Near-Daily Bombardment
segments.tr: ## लगभग दैनिक बमबारी के अधीन एक शहर

segments.src: For months, residents of el-Obeid, the capital of Sudan's North Kordofan state, have described a grim daily routine: the distant buzz of drones overhead, followed by the wait to see where the next strike will land.
segments.tr: महीनों से, सूडान के नॉर्थ कोर्डोफन राज्य की राजधानी अल-ओबेद के निवासियों ने एक भयानक दैनिक दिनचर्या का वर्णन किया है: ऊपर ड्रोन की दूर की गूंज, और उसके बाद यह देखने का इंतज़ार कि अगला हमला कहाँ होगा।

segments.src: Humanitarian monitors tracking the conflict say the city has absorbed dozens of drone attacks in a matter of weeks — by some counts, roughly forty strikes have hit the area — as fighting between Sudan's army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) grinds through its third year.
segments.tr: संघर्ष पर नज़र रखने वाले मानवीय निगरानीकर्ताओं का कहना है कि शहर ने कुछ ही हफ्तों में दर्जनों ड्रोन हमलों को झेला है — कुछ गणनाओं के अनुसार, इस क्षेत्र में लगभग चालीस हमले हुए हैं — क्योंकि सूडान की सेना और अर्धसैनिक रैपिड सपोर्ट फोर्सेज (RSF) के बीच लड़ाई अपने तीसरे वर्ष में प्रवेश कर चुकी है।

segments.src: El-Obeid sits at a strategic crossroads linking Khartoum to Sudan's western regions, which is part of why it has become a flashpoint.
segments.tr: अल-ओबेद खार्तूम को सूडान के पश्चिमी क्षेत्रों से जोड़ने वाले एक रणनीतिक चौराहे पर स्थित है, जो इसका एक कारण है कि यह एक संघर्ष बिंदु बन गया है।

segments.src: Aid workers say the city has effectively been under siege, with supply routes choked off and civilians caught between advancing front lines.
segments.tr: सहायता कर्मियों का कहना है कि शहर प्रभावी रूप से घेराबंदी के अधीन रहा है, आपूर्ति मार्ग बंद हो गए हैं और नागरिक आगे बढ़ते मोर्चों के बीच फंस गए हैं।

segments.src: ## Hospitals Knocked Out of Service
segments.tr: ## अस्पताल सेवा से बाहर हो गए

segments.src: Among the most alarming consequences, according to humanitarian organizations operating in the area, is the damage inflicted on el-Obeid's already-strained health system.
segments.tr: क्षेत्र में काम करने वाले मानवीय संगठनों के अनुसार, सबसे चिंताजनक परिणामों में से एक अल-ओबेद की पहले से ही तनावग्रस्त स्वास्थ्य प्रणाली को पहुँचाया गया नुकसान है।

segments.src: Strikes attributed to the ongoing fighting have reportedly hit or forced the closure of medical facilities, stripping the city of capacity just as civilian casualties and disease outbreaks are rising.
segments.tr: रिपोर्ट्स के अनुसार, चल रही लड़ाई के कारण हुए हमलों ने चिकित्सा सुविधाओं को निशाना बनाया है या उन्हें बंद करने के लिए मजबूर किया है, जिससे शहर की क्षमता तब कम हो गई जब नागरिक हताहतों और बीमारी के प्रकोपों में वृद्धि हो रही है।

segments.src: The World Health Organization and Sudanese medical unions have repeatedly warned that attacks on hospitals violate international humanitarian law, regardless of which side is responsible, and that a functioning health system is often the difference between a contained outbreak and a public health catastrophe.
segments.tr: विश्व स्वास्थ्य संगठन और सूडानी चिकित्सा संघों ने बार-बार चेतावनी दी है कि अस्पतालों पर हमले अंतरराष्ट्रीय मानवीय कानून का उल्लंघन करते हैं, चाहे वह किसी भी पक्ष की जिम्मेदारी हो, और एक कार्यात्मक स्वास्थ्य प्रणाली अक्सर एक नियंत्रित प्रकोप और सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य आपदा के बीच का अंतर होती है।

segments.src: With fuel, medicine and staff in short supply, doctors on the ground say they are being forced to make impossible choices about who receives treatment — a situation aid groups describe as unsustainable if the bombardment continues at its current pace.
segments.tr: ईंधन, दवा और कर्मचारियों की कमी के कारण, ज़मीनी स्तर पर डॉक्टरों का कहना है कि उन्हें इस बारे में असंभव विकल्प चुनने के लिए मजबूर किया जा रहा है कि किसे उपचार मिले — एक ऐसी स्थिति जिसे सहायता समूहों ने बताया है कि यदि बमबारी वर्तमान गति से जारी रही तो यह असहनीय होगी।

segments.src: ## Cholera Spreads as Water Systems Fail
segments.tr: ## जल प्रणालियों के विफल होने से हैजा फैल रहा है

segments.src: Compounding the crisis, health officials have confirmed a spreading cholera outbreak in and around el-Obeid.
segments.tr: संकट को और गंभीर बनाते हुए, स्वास्थ्य अधिकारियों ने अल-ओबेद और उसके आसपास हैजा के फैलते प्रकोप की पुष्टि की है।

segments.src: Cholera thrives where clean water and sanitation infrastructure has broken down — conditions that sieges and displacement reliably produce.
segments.tr: हैजा वहां पनपता है जहां स्वच्छ पानी और स्वच्छता बुनियादी ढांचे का पतन हो गया है — ऐसी स्थितियां जो घेराबंदी और विस्थापन द्वारा विश्वसनीय रूप से उत्पन्न होती हैं।

segments.src: Aid agencies report that damaged water systems, overcrowded displacement sites, and the collapse of routine health services have created ideal conditions for the waterborne disease to take hold.
segments.tr: सहायता एजेंसियों की रिपोर्ट है कि क्षतिग्रस्त जल प्रणालियों, भीड़भाड़ वाले विस्थापन स्थलों और नियमित स्वास्थ्य सेवाओं के पतन ने जलजनित बीमारी के फैलने के लिए आदर्श स्थितियां पैदा कर दी हैं।

segments.src: Sudan has recorded cholera cases in multiple states since the civil war reignited in 2023, but responders say the situation in North Kordofan is especially difficult to manage because access for aid convoys remains severely restricted, limiting the delivery of oral rehydration supplies, chlorine tablets and vaccines.
segments.tr: 2023 में गृहयुद्ध फिर से शुरू होने के बाद से सूडान ने कई राज्यों में हैजा के मामलों को दर्ज किया है, लेकिन प्रतिक्रियाकर्ताओं का कहना है कि नॉर्थ कोर्डोफन में स्थिति का प्रबंधन करना विशेष रूप से कठिन है क्योंकि सहायता काफिलों के लिए पहुंच अभी भी गंभीर रूप से प्रतिबंधित है, जिससे मौखिक पुनर्जलीकरण आपूर्ति, क्लोरीन टैबलेट और टीकों की डिलीवरी सीमित हो गई है।

segments.src: ## The UN's Warning: A Pattern That Precedes Atrocities
segments.tr: ## संयुक्त राष्ट्र की चेतावनी: एक पैटर्न जो {Atrocities} से पहले आता है

segments.src: United Nations officials monitoring Sudan have pointed to el-Obeid as an example of a broader and deeply concerning pattern: repeated strikes on civilian infrastructure, blocked humanitarian access, and the targeting of essential services in besieged areas.
segments.tr: सूडान की निगरानी करने वाले संयुक्त राष्ट्र के अधिकारियों ने अल-ओबेद को एक व्यापक और गहराई से चिंताजनक पैटर्न के उदाहरण के रूप में बताया है: नागरिक बुनियादी ढांचे पर बार-बार हमले, मानवीय पहुंच को रोकना, और घेराबंदी वाले क्षेत्रों में आवश्यक सेवाओं को निशाना बनाना।

segments.src: UN representatives have cautioned that this combination of tactics — documented elsewhere in Sudan's war, including in Darfur — has historically preceded some of the gravest violations of international law, and they have urged both the Sudanese Armed Forces and the RSF to allow unimpeded humanitarian access and to protect civilians and medical facilities under international humanitarian law.
segments.tr: संयुक्त राष्ट्र के प्रतिनिधियों ने चेतावनी दी है कि रणनीति का यह संयोजन — जो सूडान के युद्ध में अन्य जगहों पर, जिसमें दारफुर भी शामिल है, प्रलेखित है — ऐतिहासिक रूप से अंतरराष्ट्रीय कानून के कुछ सबसे गंभीर उल्लंघनों से पहले आया है, और उन्होंने सूडानी सशस्त्र बलों और RSF दोनों से बिना किसी बाधा के मानवीय पहुंच की अनुमति देने और अंतरराष्ट्रीय मानवीय कानून के तहत नागरिकों और चिकित्सा सुविधाओं की रक्षा करने का आग्रह किया है।

segments.src: Human rights researchers note that sieges which cut off food, water, fuel and medicine can constitute collective punishment of civilian populations, a serious violation regardless of the military objectives claimed by the parties involved.
segments.tr: मानवाधिकार शोधकर्ताओं का कहना है कि घेराबंदी जो भोजन, पानी, ईंधन और दवा को काट देती है, नागरिक आबादी के सामूहिक दंड के समान हो सकती है, जो शामिल पक्षों द्वारा दावा किए गए सैन्य उद्देश्यों की परवाह किए बिना एक गंभीर उल्लंघन है।

segments.src: The UN has called for independent investigations into strikes on hospitals and for accountability mechanisms to be strengthened as the conflict continues.
segments.tr: संयुक्त राष्ट्र ने अस्पतालों पर हमलों की स्वतंत्र जांच और संघर्ष जारी रहने के साथ जवाबदेही तंत्र को मजबूत करने का आह्वान किया है।

segments.src: ## A Wider Humanitarian Emergency
segments.tr: ## एक व्यापक मानवीय आपातकाल

segments.src: Sudan's civil war has already produced one of the world's largest displacement crises, with the UN estimating that millions of people have fled their homes since fighting began in April 2023.
segments.tr: सूडान के गृहयुद्ध ने पहले ही दुनिया के सबसे बड़े विस्थापन संकटों में से एक पैदा कर दिया है, संयुक्त राष्ट्र का अनुमान है कि अप्रैल 2023 से लड़ाई शुरू होने के बाद से लाखों लोग अपने घरों से भाग गए हैं।

segments.src: El-Obeid's situation reflects a broader trend across contested areas of the country, where famine conditions, disease outbreaks and attacks on civilian infrastructure have converged.
segments.tr: अल-ओबेद की स्थिति देश के विवादित क्षेत्रों में एक व्यापक प्रवृत्ति को दर्शाती है, जहां अकाल की स्थिति, बीमारी के प्रकोप और नागरिक बुनियादी ढांचे पर हमले एक साथ मिले हैं।

segments.src: International aid organizations have appealed for expanded humanitarian corridors and increased funding, warning that without a sustained ceasefire and guaranteed access for relief workers, cities like el-Obeid risk becoming case studies in how modern sieges can escalate into humanitarian catastrophes.
segments.tr: अंतरराष्ट्रीय सहायता संगठनों ने विस्तारित मानवीय गलियारों और बढ़ी हुई फंडिंग की अपील की है, चेतावनी दी है कि निरंतर युद्धविराम और राहत कर्मियों के लिए गारंटीकृत पहुंच के बिना, अल-ओबेद जैसे शहर इस बात के केस स्टडीज बन सकते हैं कि कैसे आधुनिक घेराबंदी मानवीय आपदाओं में बदल सकती है।

segments.src: For now, residents say they are left to weather both the drones overhead and the disease spreading in the shadows below — waiting for a diplomatic breakthrough that, so far, has remained out of reach.
segments.tr: फिलहाल, निवासियों का कहना है कि उन्हें ऊपर ड्रोन और नीचे परछाइयों में फैल रही बीमारी के बीच रहने के लिए छोड़ दिया गया है — एक राजनयिक सफलता के इंतज़ार में जो, अब तक, पहुंच से बाहर रही है।

es.title: Cuarenta drones sobre una ciudad: dentro del asedio que la ONU califica como una señal de advertencia de atrocidades masivas

segments.src: ## A City Under Near-Daily Bombardment
segments.tr: ## Una ciudad bajo bombardeo casi diario

segments.src: For months, residents of el-Obeid, the capital of Sudan's North Kordofan state, have described a grim daily routine: the distant buzz of drones overhead, followed by the wait to see where the next strike will land.
segments.tr: Durante meses, los residentes de el-Obeid, la capital del estado de North Kordofan en Sudán, han descrito una rutina diaria sombría: el zumbido distante de los drones en el aire, seguido de la espera para ver dónde caerá el próximo ataque.

segments.src: Humanitarian monitors tracking the conflict say the city has absorbed dozens of drone attacks in a matter of weeks — by some counts, roughly forty strikes have hit the area — as fighting between Sudan's army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) grinds through its third year.
segments.tr: Los monitores humanitarios que siguen el conflicto afirman que la ciudad ha absorbido decenas de ataques con drones en cuestión de semanas; según algunos recuentos, aproximadamente cuarenta ataques han golpeado la zona, mientras los combates entre el ejército de Sudán y las Fuerzas de Apoyo Rápido (RSF) paramilitares se prolongan en su tercer año.

segments.src: El-Obeid sits at a strategic crossroads linking Khartoum to Sudan's western regions, which is part of why it has become a flashpoint.
segments.tr: El-Obeid se encuentra en una encrucijada estratégica que conecta Jartum con las regiones occidentales de Sudán, razón por la cual se ha convertido en un punto crítico.

segments.src: Aid workers say the city has effectively been under siege, with supply routes choked off and civilians caught between advancing front lines.
segments.tr: Los trabajadores humanitarios afirman que la ciudad ha estado efectivamente bajo asedio, con las rutas de suministro bloqueadas y los civiles atrapados entre las líneas de frente que avanzan.

segments.src: ## Hospitals Knocked Out of Service
segments.tr: ## Hospitales fuera de servicio

segments.src: Among the most alarming consequences, according to humanitarian organizations operating in the area, is the damage inflicted on el-Obeid's already-strained health system.
segments.tr: Entre las consecuencias más alarmantes, según las organizaciones humanitarias que operan en la zona, se encuentra el daño infligido al ya tensionado sistema de salud de el-Obeid.

segments.src: Strikes attributed to the ongoing fighting have reportedly hit or forced the closure of medical facilities, stripping the city of capacity just as civilian casualties and disease outbreaks are rising.
segments.tr: Se informa que los ataques atribuidos a los combates en curso han golpeado o forzado el cierre de instalaciones médicas, despojando a la ciudad de su capacidad justo cuando aumentan las bajas civiles y los brotes de enfermedades.

segments.src: The World Health Organization and Sudanese medical unions have repeatedly warned that attacks on hospitals violate international humanitarian law, regardless of which side is responsible, and that a functioning health system is often the difference between a contained outbreak and a public health catastrophe.
segments.tr: La Organización Mundial de la Salud y los sindicatos médicos sudaneses han advertido repetidamente que los ataques a los hospitales violan el derecho internacional humanitario, independientemente de quién sea el responsable, y que un sistema de salud funcional es a menudo la diferencia entre un brote contenido y una catástrofe de salud pública.

segments.src: With fuel, medicine and staff in short supply, doctors on the ground say they are being forced to make impossible choices about who receives treatment — a situation aid groups describe as unsustainable if the bombardment continues at its current pace.
segments.tr: Con el combustible, las medicinas y el personal en escasez, los médicos en el terreno afirman que se ven obligados a tomar decisiones imposibles sobre quién recibe tratamiento, una situación que los grupos de ayuda describen como insostenible si el bombardeo continúa al ritmo actual.

segments.src: ## Cholera Spreads as Water Systems Fail
segments.tr: ## El cólera se propaga mientras fallan los sistemas de agua

segments.src: Compounding the crisis, health officials have confirmed a spreading cholera outbreak in and around el-Obeid.
segments.tr: Agravando la crisis, los funcionarios de salud han confirmado un brote de cólera que se propaga en el-Obeid y sus alrededores.

segments.src: Cholera thrives where clean water and sanitation infrastructure has broken down — conditions that sieges and displacement reliably produce.
segments.tr: El cólera prospera donde la infraestructura de agua limpia y saneamiento se ha desmoronado, condiciones que los asedios y el desplazamiento producen de manera fiable.

segments.src: Aid agencies report that damaged water systems, overcrowded displacement sites, and the collapse of routine health services have created ideal conditions for the waterborne disease to take hold.
segments.tr: Las agencias de ayuda informan que los sistemas de agua dañados, los sitios de desplazamiento superpoblados y el colapso de los servicios de salud rutinarios han creado las condiciones ideales para que la enfermedad transmitida por el agua se asiente.

segments.src: Sudan has recorded cholera cases in multiple states since the civil war reignited in 2023, but responders say the situation in North Kordofan is especially difficult to manage because access for aid convoys remains severely restricted, limiting the delivery of oral rehydration supplies, chlorine tablets and vaccines.
segments.tr: Sudán ha registrado casos de cólera en múltiples estados desde que la guerra civil se reavivó en 2023, pero los rescatistas afirman que la situación en North Kordofan es especialmente difícil de manejar debido a que el acceso para los convoyes de ayuda sigue estando severamente restringido, limitando la entrega de suministros de rehidratación oral, tabletas de cloro y vacunas.

segments.src: ## The UN's Warning: A Pattern That Precedes Atrocities
segments.tr: ## La advertencia de la ONU: un patrón que precede a las atrocidades

segments.src: United Nations officials monitoring Sudan have pointed to el-Obeid as an example of a broader and deeply concerning pattern: repeated strikes on civilian infrastructure, blocked humanitarian access, and the targeting of essential services in besieged areas.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios de las Naciones Unidas que monitorean Sudán han señalado a el-Obeid como un ejemplo de un patrón más amplio y profundamente preocupante: ataques repetidos a la infraestructura civil, acceso humanitario bloqueado y el ataque a servicios esenciales en áreas sitiadas.

segments.src: UN representatives have cautioned that this combination of tactics — documented elsewhere in Sudan's war, including in Darfur — has historically preceded some of the gravest violations of international law, and they have urged both the Sudanese Armed Forces and the RSF to allow unimpeded humanitarian access and to protect civilians and medical facilities under international humanitarian law.
segments.tr: Los representantes de la ONU han advertido que esta combinación de tácticas —documentada en otros lugares de la guerra de Sudán, incluyendo Darfur— ha precedido históricamente a algunas de las violaciones más graves del derecho internacional, y han instado a las Fuerzas Armadas Sudanesas y a las RSF a permitir el acceso humanitario sin impedimentos y a proteger a los civiles y las instalaciones médicas bajo el derecho internacional humanitario.

segments.src: Human rights researchers note that sieges which cut off food, water, fuel and medicine can constitute collective punishment of civilian populations, a serious violation regardless of the military objectives claimed by the parties involved.
segments.tr: Los investigadores de derechos humanos señalan que los asedios que cortan el suministro de alimentos, agua, combustible y medicinas pueden constituir un castigo colectivo de las poblaciones civiles, una violación grave independientemente de los objetivos militares alegados por las partes involucradas.

segments.src: The UN has called for independent investigations into strikes on hospitals and for accountability mechanisms to be strengthened as the conflict continues.
segments.tr: La ONU ha pedido investigaciones independientes sobre los ataques a los hospitales y que se fortalezcan los mecanismos de responsabilidad mientras el conflicto continúa.

segments.src: ## A Wider Humanitarian Emergency
segments.tr: ## Una emergencia humanitaria más amplia

segments.src: Sudan's civil war has already produced one of the world's largest displacement crises, with the UN estimating that millions of people have fled their homes since fighting began in April 2023.
segments.tr: La guerra civil de Sudán ya ha producido una de las crisis de desplazamiento más grandes del mundo, y la ONU estima que millones de personas han huido de sus hogares desde que los combates comenzaron en abril de 2023.

segments.src: El-Obeid's situation reflects a broader trend across contested areas of the country, where famine conditions, disease outbreaks and attacks on civilian infrastructure have converged.

ar.title: أربعون طائرة مسيرة فوق مدينة واحدة: نظرة داخل الحصار الذي تصفه الأمم المتحدة بأنه علامة تحذير من فظائع جماعية

segments.src: ## A City Under Near-Daily Bombardment
segments.tr: ## مدينة تحت القصف اليومي تقريباً

segments.src: For months, residents of el-Obeid, the capital of Sudan's North Kordofan state, have described a grim daily routine: the distant buzz of drones overhead, followed by the wait to see where the next strike will land.
segments.tr: لشهور، وصف سكان مدينة الأبيض، عاصمة ولاية شمال كردفان في السودان، روتيناً يومياً قاتماً: طنين بعيد لطائرات مسيرة في السماء، يليه انتظار لمعرفة أين ستسقط الضربة التالية.

segments.src: Humanitarian monitors tracking the conflict say the city has absorbed dozens of drone attacks in a matter of weeks — by some counts, roughly forty strikes have hit the area — as fighting between Sudan's army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) grinds through its third year.
segments.tr: يقول مراقبون إنسانيون يتتبعون الصراع إن المدينة تعرضت لعشرات الهجمات بطائرات مسيرة في غضون أسابيع قليلة - وبحسب بعض الإحصائيات، ضربت المنطقة حوالي أربعين ضربة - بينما يستمر القتال بين الجيش السوداني وقوات الدعم السريع (RSF) في عامه الثالث.

segments.src: El-Obeid sits at a strategic crossroads linking Khartoum to Sudan's western regions, which is part of why it has become a flashpoint.
segments.tr: تقع الأبيض في مفترق طرق استراتيجي يربط الخرطوم بالمناطق الغربية من السودان، وهو جزء من سبب تحولها إلى نقطة اشتعال.

segments.src: Aid workers say the city has effectively been under siege, with supply routes choked off and civilians caught between advancing front lines.
segments.tr: يقول عمال الإغاثة إن المدينة كانت فعلياً تحت الحصار، حيث تم خنق طرق الإمداد وحوصر المدنيون بين خطوط الجبهة المتقدمة.

segments.src: ## Hospitals Knocked Out of Service
segments.tr: ## المستشفيات تخرج عن الخدمة

segments.src: Among the most alarming consequences, according to humanitarian organizations operating in the area, is the damage inflicted on el-Obeid's already-strained health system.
segments.tr: من بين العواقب الأكثر إثارة للقلق، وفقاً للمنظمات الإنسانية العاملة في المنطقة، هو الضرر الذي لحق بالنظام الصحي في الأبيض المجهد بالفعل.

segments.src: Strikes attributed to the ongoing fighting have reportedly hit or forced the closure of medical facilities, stripping the city of capacity just as civilian casualties and disease outbreaks are rising.
segments.tr: أفادت التقارير أن الضربات المنسوبة إلى القتال المستمر قد أصابت أو أجبرت المرافق الطبية على الإغلاق، مما حرم المدينة من قدراتها في وقت تتزايد فيه الإصابات بين المدنيين وتفشي الأمراض.

segments.src: The World Health Organization and Sudanese medical unions have repeatedly warned that attacks on hospitals violate international humanitarian law, regardless of which side is responsible, and that a functioning health system is often the difference between a contained outbreak and a public health catastrophe.
segments.tr: حذرت منظمة الصحة العالمية والنقابات الطبية السودانية مراراً وتكراراً من أن الهجمات على المستشفيات تنتهك القانون الإنساني الدولي، بغض النظر عن الطرف المسؤول، وأن وجود نظام صحي يعمل غالباً ما يكون هو الفرق بين تفشٍ محدود وكارثة صحية عامة.

segments.src: With fuel, medicine and staff in short supply, doctors on the ground say they are being forced to make impossible choices about who receives treatment — a situation aid groups describe as unsustainable if the bombardment continues at its current pace.
segments.tr: مع نقص الوقود والأدوية والموظفين، يقول الأطباء الميدانيون إنهم يضطرون لاتخاذ خيارات مستحيلة بشأن من يتلقى العلاج - وهو وضع تصفه مجموعات الإغاثة بأنه غير مستدام إذا استمر القصف بالوتيرة الحالية.

segments.src: ## Cholera Spreads as Water Systems Fail
segments.tr: ## الكوليرا تنتشر مع تعطل أنظمة المياه

segments.src: Compounding the crisis, health officials have confirmed a spreading cholera outbreak in and around el-Obeid.
segments.tr: ومما يزيد من تفاقم الأزمة، أكد المسؤولون الصحيون تفشي مرض الكوليرا في الأبيض ومحيطها.

segments.src: Cholera thrives where clean water and sanitation infrastructure has broken down — conditions that sieges and displacement reliably produce.
segments.tr: تزدهر الكوليرا حيث تنهار البنية التحتية للمياه النظيفة والصرف الصحي - وهي ظروف ينتجها الحصار والنزوح بشكل مؤكد.

segments.src: Aid agencies report that damaged water systems, overcrowded displacement sites, and the collapse of routine health services have created ideal conditions for the waterborne disease to take hold.
segments.tr: أفادت وكالات الإغاثة أن أنظمة المياه المتضررة، ومواقع النزوح المكتظة، وانهيار الخدمات الصحية الروتينية قد خلقت ظروفاً مثالية لانتشار المرض المنقول بالمياه.

segments.src: Sudan has recorded cholera cases in multiple states since the civil war reignited in 2023, but responders say the situation in North Kordofan is especially difficult to manage because access for aid convoys remains severely restricted, limiting the delivery of oral rehydration supplies, chlorine tablets and vaccines.
segments.tr: سجل السودان حالات كوليرا في ولايات متعددة منذ تجدد الحرب الأهلية في 2023، لكن المستجيبين يقولون إن الوضع في شمال كردفان يصعب إدارته بشكل خاص لأن وصول قوافل المساعدات لا يزال مقيداً بشدة، مما يحد من تسليم إمدادات إعادة الترطيب الفموي وأقراص الكلور واللقاحات.

segments.src: ## The UN's Warning: A Pattern That Precedes Atrocities
segments.tr: ## تحذير الأمم المتحدة: نمط يسبق الفظائع

segments.src: United Nations officials monitoring Sudan have pointed to el-Obeid as an example of a broader and deeply concerning pattern: repeated strikes on civilian infrastructure, blocked humanitarian access, and the targeting of essential services in besieged areas.
segments.tr: أشار مسؤولو الأمم المتحدة الذين يراقبون السودان إلى مدينة الأبيض كمثال على نمط أوسع ومثير للقلق العميق: ضربات متكررة على البنية التحتية المدنية، ومنع وصول المساعدات الإنسانية، واستهداف الخدمات الأساسية في المناطق المحاصرة.

segments.src: UN representatives have cautioned that this combination of tactics — documented elsewhere in Sudan's war, including in Darfur — has historically preceded some of the gravest violations of international law, and they have urged both the Sudanese Armed Forces and the RSF to allow unimpeded humanitarian access and to protect civilians and medical facilities under international humanitarian law.
segments.tr: حذر ممثلو الأمم المتحدة من أن هذا المزيج من التكتيكات - الموثقة في أماكن أخرى من حرب السودان، بما في ذلك دارفور - قد سبق تاريخياً بعض أخطر الانتهاكات للقانون الدولي، وحثوا كل من القوات المسلحة السودانية وقوات الدعم السريع على السماح بوصول إنساني غير مقيد وحماية المدنيين والمرافق الطبية بموجب القانون الإنساني الدولي.

segments.src: Human rights researchers note that sieges which cut off food, water, fuel and medicine can constitute collective punishment of civilian populations, a serious violation regardless of the military objectives claimed by the parties involved.
segments.tr: يشير باحثو حقوق الإنسان إلى أن الحصار الذي يقطع الغذاء والماء والوقود والدواء يمكن أن يشكل عقاباً جماعياً للسكان المدنيين، وهو انتهاك خطير بغض النظر عن الأهداف العسكرية التي تدعيها الأطراف المعنية.

segments.src: The UN has called for independent investigations into strikes on hospitals and for accountability mechanisms to be strengthened as the conflict continues.
segments.tr: دعت الأمم المتحدة إلى إجراء تحقيقات مستقلة في الضربات التي استهدفت المستشفيات وتعزيز آليات المساءلة مع استمرار الصراع.

segments.src: ## A Wider Humanitarian Emergency
segments.tr: ## حالة طوارئ إنسانية أوسع

segments.src: Sudan's civil war has already produced one of the world's largest displacement crises, with the UN estimating that millions of people have fled their homes since fighting began in April 2023.
segments.tr: لقد أنتجت الحرب الأهلية في السودان بالفعل واحدة من أكبر أزمات النزوح في العالم، حيث تقدر الأمم المتحدة أن ملايين الأشخاص فروا من منازلهم منذ بدء القتال في أبريل 2023.

segments.src: El-Obeid's situation reflects a broader trend across contested areas of the country, where famine conditions, disease outbreaks and attacks on civilian infrastructure have converged.
segments.tr: يعكس وضع الأبيض توجهاً أوسع في المناطق المتنازع عليها في البلاد، حيث تلاقت ظروف المجاعة، وتفشي الأمراض، والهجمات على البنية التحتية المدنية.

segments.src: International aid organizations have appealed for expanded humanitarian corridors and increased funding, warning that without a sustained ceasefire and guaranteed access for relief workers, cities like el-Obeid risk becoming case studies in how modern sieges can escalate into humanitarian catastrophes.
segments.tr: ناشدت منظمات الإغاثة الدولية توسيع الممرات الإنسانية وزيادة التمويل، محذرة من أنه بدون وقف إطلاق نار مستدام ووصول مضمون لعمال الإغاثة، فإن مدناً مثل الأبيض تخاطر بأن تصبح دراسات حالة في كيفية تحول الحصار الحديث إلى كوارث إنسانية.

segments.src: For now, residents say they are left to weather both the drones overhead and the disease spreading in the shadows below — waiting for a diplomatic breakthrough that, so far, has remained out of reach.
segments.tr: في الوقت الحالي، يقول السكان إنهم متروكون لمواجهة كل من الطائرات المسيرة في السماء والمرض الذي ينتشر في الظلال أدناه - في انتظار اختراق دبلوماسي ظل، حتى الآن، بعيد المنال.

fr.title: Quarante drones sur une seule ville : au cœur du siège que l'ONU qualifie de signe avant-coureur d'atrocités de masse

segments.src: ## A City Under Near-Daily Bombardment
segments.tr: ## Une ville sous bombardements quasi quotidiens

segments.src: For months, residents of el-Obeid, the capital of Sudan's North Kordofan state, have described a grim daily routine: the distant buzz of drones overhead, followed by the wait to see where the next strike will land.
segments.tr: Depuis des mois, les habitants d'El-Obeid, la capitale de l'État du Nord-Kordofan au Soudan, décrivent une routine quotidienne sinistre : le bourdonnement lointain de drones au-dessus de leurs têtes, suivi de l'attente pour voir où frappera la prochaine attaque.

segments.src: Humanitarian monitors tracking the conflict say the city has absorbed dozens of drone attacks in a matter of weeks — by some counts, roughly forty strikes have hit the area — as fighting between Sudan's army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) grinds through its third year.
segments.tr: Les observateurs humanitaires qui suivent le conflit affirment que la ville a subi des dizaines d'attaques de drones en quelques semaines — selon certains décomptes, environ quarante frappes ont touché la zone — alors que les combats entre l'armée soudanaise et les Forces de soutien rapide (RSF) entrent dans leur troisième année.

segments.src: El-Obeid sits at a strategic crossroads linking Khartoum to Sudan's western regions, which is part of why it has become a flashpoint.
segments.tr: El-Obeid se trouve à un carrefour stratégique reliant Khartoum aux régions occidentales du Soudan, ce qui explique en partie pourquoi elle est devenue un point de tension.

segments.src: Aid workers say the city has effectively been under siege, with supply routes choked off and civilians caught between advancing front lines.
segments.tr: Les travailleurs humanitaires affirment que la ville est effectivement sous siège, les routes d'approvisionnement étant bloquées et les civils pris entre des lignes de front progressives.

segments.src: ## Hospitals Knocked Out of Service
segments.tr: ## Des hôpitaux mis hors service

segments.src: Among the most alarming consequences, according to humanitarian organizations operating in the area, is the damage inflicted on el-Obeid's already-strained health system.
segments.tr: Parmi les conséquences les plus alarmantes, selon les organisations humanitaires opérant dans la zone, figurent les dommages infligés au système de santé d'El-Obeid, déjà sous pression.

segments.src: Strikes attributed to the ongoing fighting have reportedly hit or forced the closure of medical facilities, stripping the city of capacity just as civilian casualties and disease outbreaks are rising.
segments.tr: Des frappes attribuées aux combats en cours auraient touché ou forcé la fermeture d'installations médicales, privant la ville de sa capacité de soin juste au moment où les victimes civiles et les épidémies de maladies augmentent.

segments.src: The World Health Organization and Sudanese medical unions have repeatedly warned that attacks on hospitals violate international humanitarian law, regardless of which side is responsible, and that a functioning health system is often the difference between a contained outbreak and a public health catastrophe.
segments.tr: L'Organisation mondiale de la santé et les syndicats médicaux soudanais ont averti à plusieurs reprises que les attaques contre les hôpitaux violent le droit international humanitaire, quel que soit le camp responsable, et qu'un système de santé fonctionnel est souvent la différence entre une épidémie contenue et une catastrophe de santé publique.

segments.src: With fuel, medicine and staff in short supply, doctors on the ground say they are being forced to make impossible choices about who receives treatment — a situation aid groups describe as unsustainable if the bombardment continues at its current pace.
segments.tr: Avec une pénurie de carburant, de médicaments et de personnel, les médecins sur le terrain disent être contraints de faire des choix impossibles quant à savoir qui reçoit des soins — une situation que les groupes d'aide décrivent comme insoutenable si les bombardements se poursuivent au rythme actuel.

segments.src: ## Cholera Spreads as Water Systems Fail
segments.tr: ## Le choléra se propage alors que les systèmes d'eau échouent

segments.src: Compounding the crisis, health officials have confirmed a spreading cholera outbreak in and around el-Obeid.
segments.tr: Aggravant la crise, les responsables de la santé ont confirmé la propagation d'une épidémie de choléra à El-Obeid et dans ses environs.

segments.src: Cholera thrives where clean water and sanitation infrastructure has broken down — conditions that sieges and displacement reliably produce.
segments.tr: Le choléra prospère là où l'infrastructure d'eau potable et d'assainissement s'est effondrée — des conditions que les sièges et les déplacements de population produisent systématiquement.

segments.src: Aid agencies report that damaged water systems, overcrowded displacement sites, and the collapse of routine health services have created ideal conditions for the waterborne disease to take hold.
segments.tr: Les agences d'aide rapportent que les systèmes d'eau endommagés, les sites de déplacement surpeuplés et l'effondrement des services de santé de routine ont créé des conditions idéales pour l'installation de cette maladie transmise par l'eau.

segments.src: Sudan has recorded cholera cases in multiple states since the civil war reignited in 2023, but responders say the situation in North Kordofan is especially difficult to manage because access for aid convoys remains severely restricted, limiting the delivery of oral rehydration supplies, chlorine tablets and vaccines.
segments.tr: Le Soudan a enregistré des cas de choléra dans plusieurs États depuis que la guerre civile a repris en 2023, mais les intervenants disent que la situation au Nord-Kordofan est particulièrement difficile à gérer car l'accès pour les convois d'aide reste sévèrement restreint, limitant la livraison de fournitures de réhydratation orale, de comprimés de chlore et de vaccins.

segments.src: ## The UN's Warning: A Pattern That Precedes Atrocities
segments.tr: ## L'avertissement de l'ONU : un schéma qui précède les atrocités

segments.src: United Nations officials monitoring Sudan have pointed to el-Obeid as an example of a broader and deeply concerning pattern: repeated strikes on civilian infrastructure, blocked humanitarian access, and the targeting of essential services in besieged areas.
segments.tr: Les responsables des Nations Unies qui surveillent le Soudan ont désigné El-Obeid comme l'exemple d'un schéma plus large et profondément préoccupant : des frappes répétées sur les infrastructures civiles, un accès humanitaire bloqué et le ciblage des services essentiels dans les zones assiégées.

segments.src: UN representatives have cautioned that this combination of tactics — documented elsewhere in Sudan's war, including in Darfur — has historically preceded some of the gravest violations of international law, and they have urged both the Sudanese Armed Forces and the RSF to allow unimpeded humanitarian access and to protect civilians and medical facilities under international humanitarian law.
segments.tr: Les représentants de l'ONU ont averti que cette combinaison de tactiques — documentée ailleurs dans la guerre du Soudan, notamment au Darfour — a historiquement précédé certaines des violations les plus graves du droit international, et ils ont exhorté les Forces armées soudanaises et les RSF à permettre un accès humanitaire sans entrave et à protéger les civils et les installations médicales conformément au droit international humanitaire.

segments.src: Human rights researchers note that sieges which cut off food, water, fuel and medicine can constitute collective punishment of civilian populations, a serious violation regardless of the military objectives claimed by the parties involved.
segments.tr: Les chercheurs en droits de l'homme notent que les sièges qui coupent l'alimentation en nourriture, eau, carburant et médicaments peuvent constituer une punition collective des populations civiles, une violation grave quels que soient les objectifs militaires revendiqués par les parties concernées.

segments.src: The UN has called for independent investigations into strikes on hospitals and for accountability mechanisms to be strengthened as the conflict continues.
segments.tr: L'ONU a appelé à des enquêtes indépendantes sur les frappes contre les hôpitaux et au renforcement des mécanismes de responsabilité alors que le conflit se poursuit.

segments.src: ## A Wider Humanitarian Emergency
segments.tr: ## Une urgence humanitaire plus large

segments.src: Sudan's civil war has already produced one of the world's largest displacement crises, with the UN estimating that millions of people have fled their homes since fighting began in April 2023.
segments.tr: La guerre civile soudanaise a déjà produit l'une des plus grandes crises de déplacement au monde, l'ONU estimant que des millions de personnes ont fui leur foyer depuis que les combats ont commencé en avril 2023.

segments.src: El-Obeid's situation reflects a broader trend across contested areas of the country, where famine conditions, disease outbreaks and attacks on civilian infrastructure have converged.
segments.tr: La situation d'El-Obeid reflète une tendance plus large dans les zones contestées du pays, où les conditions de famine, les épidémies de maladies et les attaques contre les infrastructures civiles ont convergé.

segments.src: International aid organizations have appealed for expanded humanitarian corridors and increased funding, warning that without a sustained ceasefire and guaranteed access for relief workers, cities like el-Obeid risk becoming case studies in how modern sieges can escalate into humanitarian catastrophes.
segments.tr: Les organisations d'aide internationales ont appelé à l'élargissement des corridors humanitaires et à l'augmentation du financement, avertissant que sans un cessez-le-feu durable et un accès garanti pour les travailleurs de secours, des villes comme El-Obeid risquent de devenir des études de cas sur la manière dont les sièges modernes peuvent dégénérer en catastrophes humanitaires.

segments.src: For now, residents say they are left to weather both the drones overhead and the disease spreading in the shadows below — waiting for a diplomatic breakthrough that, so far, has remained out of reach.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, les habitants disent qu'ils sont laissés à subir à la fois les drones au-dessus d'eux et la maladie qui se propage dans l'ombre en dessous — attendant une percée diplomatique qui, jusqu'à présent, est restée hors de portée.
