segments.tr: Com a escassez de combustível, medicamentos e pessoal, os médicos no local afirmam que estão sendo forçados a fazer escolhas impossíveis sobre quem recebe tratamento — uma situação que grupos de ajuda descrevem como insustentável se o bombardeio continuar no ritmo atual.

segments.src: ## Cholera Spreads as Water Systems Fail
segments.tr: ## Cólera se Espalha com a Falha dos Sistemas de Água

segments.src: Compounding the crisis, health officials have confirmed a spreading cholera outbreak in and around el-Obeid.
segments.tr: Agravando a crise, autoridades de saúde confirmaram um surto de cólera que se espalha em el-Obeid e arredores.

segments.src: Cholera thrives where clean water and sanitation infrastructure has broken down — conditions that sieges and displacement reliably produce.
segments.tr: A cólera prospera onde a água limpa e a infraestrutura de saneamento entraram em colapso — condições que cercos e deslocamentos produzem invariavelmente.

segments.src: Aid agencies report that damaged water systems, overcrowded displacement sites, and the collapse of routine health services have created ideal conditions for the waterborne disease to take hold.
segments.tr: Agências de ajuda relatam que sistemas de água danificados, locais de deslocamento superlotados e o colapso dos serviços de saúde rotineiros criaram as condições ideais para que a doença transmitida pela água se estabelecesse.

segments.src: Sudan has recorded cholera cases in multiple states since the civil war reignited in 2023, but responders say the situation in North Kordofan is especially difficult to manage because access for aid convoys remains severely restricted, limiting the delivery of oral rehydration supplies, chlorine tablets and vaccines.
segments.tr: O Sudão registrou casos de cólera em múltiplos estados desde que a guerra civil recomeçou em 2023, mas os socorristas afirmam que a situação em North Kordofan é especialmente difícil de gerenciar porque o acesso para comboios de ajuda permanece severamente restringido, limitando a entrega de suprimentos de reidratação oral, pastilhas de cloro e vacinas.

segments.src: ## The UN's Warning: A Pattern That Precedes Atrocities
segments.tr: ## O Alerta da ONU: Um Padrão que Precede Atrocidades

segments.src: United Nations officials monitoring Sudan have pointed to el-Obeid as an example of a broader and deeply concerning pattern: repeated strikes on civilian infrastructure, blocked humanitarian access, and the targeting of essential services in besieged areas.
segments.tr: Funcionários das Nações Unidas que monitoram o Sudão apontaram el-Obeid como um exemplo de um padrão mais amplo e profundamente preocupante: ataques repetidos a infraestruturas civis, bloqueio do acesso humanitário e a focalização de serviços essenciais em áreas cercadas.

segments.src: UN representatives have cautioned that this combination of tactics — documented elsewhere in Sudan's war, including in Darfur — has historically preceded some of the gravest violations of international law, and they have urged both the Sudanese Armed Forces and the RSF to allow unimpeded humanitarian access and to protect civilians and medical facilities under international humanitarian law.
segments.tr: Representantes da ONU alertaram que essa combinação de táticas — documentada em outros lugares na guerra do Sudão, incluindo em Darfur — historicamente precedeu algumas das violações mais graves do direito internacional, e instaram tanto as Forças Armadas Sudanesas quanto as RSF a permitirem o acesso humanitário desimpedido e a protegerem civis e instalações médicas sob o direito humanitário internacional.

segments.src: Human rights researchers note that sieges which cut off food, water, fuel and medicine can constitute collective punishment of civilian populations, a serious violation regardless of the military objectives claimed by the parties involved.
segments.tr: Pesquisadores de direitos humanos observam que cercos que cortam comida, água, combustível e medicamentos podem constituir punição coletiva de populações civis, uma violação grave independentemente dos objetivos militares alegados pelas partes envolvidas.

segments.src: The UN has called for independent investigations into strikes on hospitals and for accountability mechanisms to be strengthened as the conflict continues.
segments.tr: A ONU pediu investigações independentes sobre os ataques a hospitais e que os mecanismos de responsabilização sejam fortalecidos enquanto o conflito continua.

segments.src: ## A Wider Humanitarian Emergency
segments.tr: ## Uma Emergência Humanitária Mais Ampla

segments.src: Sudan's civil war has already produced one of the world's largest displacement crises, with the UN estimating that millions of people have fled their homes since fighting began in April 2023.
segments.tr: A guerra civil do Sudão já produziu uma das maiores crises de deslocamento do mundo, com a ONU estimando que milhões de pessoas fugiram de suas casas desde que os combates começaram em abril de 2023.

segments.src: El-Obeid's situation reflects a broader trend across contested areas of the country, where famine conditions, disease outbreaks and attacks on civilian infrastructure have converged.
segments.tr: A situação de el-Obeid reflete uma tendência mais ampla em áreas contestadas do país, onde condições de fome, surtos de doenças e ataques a infraestruturas civis convergiram.

segments.src: International aid organizations have appealed for expanded humanitarian corridors and increased funding, warning that without a sustained ceasefire and guaranteed access for relief workers, cities like el-Obeid risk becoming case studies in how modern sieges can escalate into humanitarian catastrophes.
segments.tr: Organizações de ajuda internacional apelaram por corredores humanitários expandidos e maior financiamento, alertando que sem um cessar-fogo sustentado e acesso garantido para trabalhadores de socorro, cidades como el-Obeid correm o risco de se tornarem estudos de caso sobre como cercos modernos podem escalar para catástrofes humanitárias.

segments.src: For now, residents say they are left to weather both the drones overhead and the disease spreading in the shadows below — waiting for a diplomatic breakthrough that, so far, has remained out of reach.
segments.tr: Por enquanto, os residentes dizem que estão deixados para enfrentar tanto os drones no céu e a doença que se espalha nas sombras abaixo — esperando por um avanço diplomático que, até agora, permaneceu fora de alcance.

in.title: Empat Puluh Drone di Atas Satu Kota: Di Dalam Pengepungan yang Disebut PBB sebagai Tanda Peringatan Atroisitas Massal

segments.src: ## A City Under Near-Daily Bombardment
segments.tr: ## Sebuah Kota di Bawah Pengeboman Hampir Setiap Hari

segments.src: For months, residents of el-Obeid, the capital of Sudan's North Kordofan state, have described a grim daily routine: the distant buzz of drones overhead, followed by the wait to see where the next strike will land.
segments.tr: Selama berbulan-bulan, penduduk el-Obeid, ibu kota negara bagian North Kordofan di Sudan, menggambarkan rutinitas harian yang suram: dengungan drone yang jauh di atas kepala, diikuti oleh penantian untuk melihat di mana serangan berikutnya akan mendarat.

segments.src: Humanitarian monitors tracking the conflict say the city has absorbed dozens of drone attacks in a matter of weeks — by some counts, roughly forty strikes have hit the area — as fighting between Sudan's army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) grinds through its third year.
segments.tr: Pemantau kemanusiaan yang melacak konflik tersebut mengatakan bahwa kota itu telah menerima lusinan serangan drone dalam hitungan minggu — menurut beberapa hitungan, sekitar empat puluh serangan telah menghantam area tersebut — saat pertempuran antara tentara Sudan dan paramiliter Rapid Support Forces (RSF) memasuki tahun ketiga.

segments.src: El-Obeid sits at a strategic crossroads linking Khartoum to Sudan's western regions, which is part of why it has become a flashpoint.
segments.tr: El-Obeid terletak di persimpangan strategis yang menghubungkan Khartoum dengan wilayah barat Sudan, yang menjadi salah satu alasan mengapa kota ini menjadi titik konflik.

segments.src: Aid workers say the city has effectively been under siege, with supply routes choked off and civilians caught between advancing front lines.
segments.tr: Pekerja bantuan mengatakan bahwa kota itu secara efektif telah dikepung, dengan rute pasokan yang terputus dan warga sipil terjebak di antara garis depan yang terus maju.

segments.src: ## Hospitals Knocked Out of Service
segments.tr: ## Rumah Sakit Lumpuh

segments.src: Among the most alarming consequences, according to humanitarian organizations operating in the area, is the damage inflicted on el-Obeid's already-strained health system.
segments.tr: Di antara konsekuensi yang paling mengkhawatirkan, menurut organisasi kemanusiaan yang beroperasi di area tersebut, adalah kerusakan yang ditimbulkan pada sistem kesehatan el-Obeid yang sudah tertekan.

segments.src: Strikes attributed to the ongoing fighting have reportedly hit or forced the closure of medical facilities, stripping the city of capacity just as civilian casualties and disease outbreaks are rising.
segments.tr: Serangan yang dikaitkan dengan pertempuran yang sedang berlangsung dilaporkan telah menghantam atau memaksa penutupan fasilitas medis, menghilangkan kapasitas kota tepat saat korban sipil dan wabah penyakit meningkat.

segments.src: The World Health Organization and Sudanese medical unions have repeatedly warned that attacks on hospitals violate international humanitarian law, regardless of which side is responsible, and that a functioning health system is often the difference between a contained outbreak and a public health catastrophe.
segments.tr: Organisasi Kesehatan Dunia dan serikat medis Sudan telah berulang kali memperingatkan bahwa serangan terhadap rumah sakit melanggar hukum kemanusiaan internasional, terlepas dari pihak mana yang bertanggung jawab, dan bahwa sistem kesehatan yang berfungsi sering kali menjadi pembeda antara wabah yang terkendali dan bencana kesehatan masyarakat.

segments.src: With fuel, medicine and staff in short supply, doctors on the ground say they are being forced to make impossible choices about who receives treatment — a situation aid groups describe as unsustainable if the bombardment continues at its current pace.
segments.tr: Dengan bahan bakar, obat-obatan, dan staf yang terbatas, dokter di lapangan mengatakan mereka terpaksa membuat pilihan mustahil tentang siapa yang menerima perawatan — situasi yang digambarkan oleh kelompok bantuan sebagai tidak berkelanjutan jika pengeboman terus berlanjut dengan kecepatan saat ini.

segments.src: ## Cholera Spreads as Water Systems Fail
segments.tr: ## Kolera Menyebar Saat Sistem Air Gagal

segments.src: Compounding the crisis, health officials have confirmed a spreading cholera outbreak in and around el-Obeid.
segments.tr: Memperburuk krisis, pejabat kesehatan telah mengonfirmasi penyebaran wabah kolera di dan sekitar el-Obeid.

segments.src: Cholera thrives where clean water and sanitation infrastructure has broken down — conditions that sieges and displacement reliably produce.
segments.tr: Kolera berkembang biak di tempat yang infrastruktur air bersih dan sanitasi telah rusak — kondisi yang secara konsisten dihasilkan oleh pengepungan dan pengungsian.

segments.src: Aid agencies report that damaged water systems, overcrowded displacement sites, and the collapse of routine health services have created ideal conditions for the waterborne disease to take hold.
segments.tr: Badan bantuan melaporkan bahwa sistem air yang rusak, lokasi pengungsian yang terlalu padat, dan runtuhnya layanan kesehatan rutin telah menciptakan kondisi ideal bagi penyakit bawaan air untuk berkembang.

segments.src: Sudan has recorded cholera cases in multiple states since the civil war reignited in 2023, but responders say the situation in North Kordofan is especially difficult to manage because access for aid convoys remains severely restricted, limiting the delivery of oral rehydration supplies, chlorine tablets and vaccines.
segments.tr: Sudan telah mencatat kasus kolera di beberapa negara bagian sejak perang saudara berkobar kembali pada 2023, tetapi petugas bantuan mengatakan situasi di North Kordofan sangat sulit dikelola karena akses bagi konvoi bantuan tetap sangat terbatas, membatasi pengiriman pasokan rehidrasi oral, tablet klorin, dan vaksin.

segments.src: ## The UN's Warning: A Pattern That Precedes Atrocities
segments.tr: ## Peringatan PBB: Pola yang Mendahului Atroisitas

segments.src: United Nations officials monitoring Sudan have pointed to el-Obeid as an example of a broader and deeply concerning pattern: repeated strikes on civilian infrastructure, blocked humanitarian access, and the targeting of essential services in besieged areas.
segments.tr: Pejabat PBB yang memantau Sudan telah menunjuk el-Obeid sebagai contoh dari pola yang lebih luas dan sangat mengkhawatirkan: serangan berulang pada infrastruktur sipil, pemblokiran akses kemanusiaan, dan penargetan layanan esensial di area yang dikepung.

segments.src: UN representatives have cautioned that this combination of tactics — documented elsewhere in Sudan's war, including in Darfur — has historically preceded some of the gravest violations of international law, and they have urged both the Sudanese Armed Forces and the RSF to allow unimpeded humanitarian access and to protect civilians and medical facilities under international humanitarian law.
segments.tr: Perwakilan PBB telah memperingatkan bahwa kombinasi taktik ini — yang didokumentasikan di tempat lain dalam perang Sudan, termasuk di Darfur — secara historis telah mendahului beberapa pelanggaran hukum internasional yang paling berat, dan mereka telah mendesak Angkatan Bersenjata Sudan dan RSF untuk mengizinkan akses kemanusiaan tanpa hambatan dan melindungi warga sipil serta fasilitas medis berdasarkan hukum kemanusiaan internasional.

segments.src: Human rights researchers note that sieges which cut off food, water, fuel and medicine can constitute collective punishment of civilian populations, a serious violation regardless of the military objectives claimed by the parties involved.
segments.tr: Peneliti hak asasi manusia mencatat bahwa pengepungan yang memutus pasokan makanan, air, bahan bakar, dan obat-obatan dapat merupakan hukuman kolektif bagi populasi sipil, sebuah pelanggaran serius terlepas dari tujuan militer yang diklaim oleh pihak-pihak yang terlibat.

segments.src: The UN has called for independent investigations into strikes on hospitals and for accountability mechanisms to be strengthened as the conflict continues.
segments.tr: PBB telah menyerukan investigasi independen terhadap serangan terhadap rumah sakit dan agar mekanisme akuntabilitas diperkuat seiring berlanjutnya konflik.

segments.src: ## A Wider Humanitarian Emergency
segments.tr: ## Darurat Kemanusiaan yang Lebih Luas

segments.src: Sudan's civil war has already produced one of the world's largest displacement crises, with the UN estimating that millions of people have fled their homes since fighting began in April 2023.
segments.tr: Perang saudara Sudan telah menghasilkan salah satu krisis pengungsian terbesar di dunia, dengan PBB memperkirakan bahwa jutaan orang telah melarikan diri dari rumah mereka sejak pertempuran dimulai pada April 2023.

segments.src: El-Obeid's situation reflects a broader trend across contested areas of the country, where famine conditions, disease outbreaks and attacks on civilian infrastructure have converged.
segments.tr: Situasi el-Obeid mencerminkan tren yang lebih luas di seluruh area yang diperebutkan di negara tersebut, di mana kondisi kelaparan, wabah penyakit, dan serangan terhadap infrastruktur sipil telah bertemu.

segments.src: International aid organizations have appealed for expanded humanitarian corridors and increased funding, warning that without a sustained ceasefire and guaranteed access for relief workers, cities like el-Obeid risk becoming case studies in how modern sieges can escalate into humanitarian catastrophes.
segments.tr: Organisasi bantuan internasional telah mengimbau perluasan koridor kemanusiaan dan peningkatan pendanaan, memperingatkan bahwa tanpa gencatan senjata yang berkelanjutan dan akses terjamin bagi pekerja bantuan, kota-kota seperti el-Obeid berisiko menjadi studi kasus tentang bagaimana pengepungan modern dapat meningkat menjadi bencana kemanusiaan.

segments.src: For now, residents say they are left to weather both the drones overhead and the disease spreading in the shadows below — waiting for a diplomatic breakthrough that, so far, has remained out of reach.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, penduduk mengatakan mereka dibiarkan menghadapi drone di atas kepala dan penyakit yang menyebar di bayang-bayang di bawah — menunggu terobosan diplomatik yang, sejauh ini, tetap tidak terjangkau.

ja.title: 1つの都市に40機のドローン：国連が大量虐殺の警告サインと呼ぶ包囲網の内側

segments.src: ## A City Under Near-Daily Bombardment
segments.tr: ## ほぼ毎日の爆撃を受ける都市

segments.src: For months, residents of el-Obeid, the capital of Sudan's North Kordofan state, have described a grim daily routine: the distant buzz of drones overhead, followed by the wait to see where the next strike will land.
segments.tr: 数ヶ月間、スーダンの北コルドファン州の州都エル・オベイドの住民は、頭上のドローンの遠い羽音に続き、次の攻撃がどこに降りかかるかを待つという、残酷な日常を語っています。

segments.src: Humanitarian monitors tracking the conflict say the city has absorbed dozens of drone attacks in a matter of weeks — by some counts, roughly forty strikes have hit the area — as fighting between Sudan's army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) grinds through its third year.
segments.tr: 紛争を追跡している人道監視員は、スーダン軍と準軍事組織の即応支援部隊（RSF）の戦闘が3年目に突入する中、この都市が数週間のうちに数十回のドローン攻撃を受けたとしており、一部の集計では、この地域に約40回の攻撃があったとしています。

segments.src: El-Obeid sits at a strategic crossroads linking Khartoum to Sudan's western regions, which is part of why it has become a flashpoint.
segments.tr: エル・オベイドは、ハルツームとスーダン西部地域を結ぶ戦略的な交差点に位置しており、それがこの地が紛争の火種となった理由の一つです。

segments.src: Aid workers say the city has effectively been under siege, with supply routes choked off and civilians caught between advancing front lines.
segments.tr: 援助活動家は、補給路が遮断され、民間人が前進する前線に挟まれたことで、この都市が事実上の包囲下に置かれていると述べています。

segments.src: ## Hospitals Knocked Out of Service
segments.tr: ## 病院が機能停止

segments.src: Among the most alarming consequences, according to humanitarian organizations operating in the area, is the damage inflicted on el-Obeid's already-strained health system.
segments.tr: この地域で活動する人道団体によると、最も深刻な結果の一つは、すでに疲弊していたエル・オベイドの保健システムへの被害です。

segments.src: Strikes attributed to the ongoing fighting have reportedly hit or forced the closure of medical facilities, stripping the city of capacity just as civilian casualties and disease outbreaks are rising.
segments.tr: 進行中の戦闘による攻撃が医療施設を直撃したか、あるいは閉鎖を余儀なくさせたとの報告があり、民間人の死傷者と病気の流行が拡大する中で、都市の対応能力が奪われています。

segments.src: The World Health Organization and Sudanese medical unions have repeatedly warned that attacks on hospitals violate international humanitarian law, regardless of which side is responsible, and that a functioning health system is often the difference between a contained outbreak and a public health catastrophe.
segments.tr: 世界保健機関（WHO）とスーダンの医療組合は、責任者が誰であれ、病院への攻撃は国際人道法に違反していると繰り返し警告し、機能している保健システムこそが、流行の封じ込めと公衆衛生上の大惨事との分かれ目になることが多いと述べています。

segments.src: With fuel, medicine and staff in short supply, doctors on the ground say they are being forced to make impossible choices about who receives treatment — a situation aid groups describe as unsustainable if the bombardment continues at its current pace.
segments.tr: 燃料、医薬品、スタッフが不足する中、現場の医師たちは、誰に治療を行うかという不可能な選択を迫られていると語っています。援助団体は、爆撃が現在のペースで続けば、この状況は持続不可能であると説明しています。

segments.src: ## Cholera Spreads as Water Systems Fail
segments.tr: ## 水システムが崩壊し、コレラが拡大

segments.src: Compounding the crisis, health officials have confirmed a spreading cholera outbreak in and around el-Obeid.
segments.tr: 危機をさらに悪化させているのは、保健当局がエル・オベイドとその周辺でコレラの流行が広がっていることを確認したことです。

segments.src: Cholera thrives where clean water and sanitation infrastructure has broken down — conditions that sieges and displacement reliably produce.
segments.tr: コレラは、清潔な水と衛生インフラが崩壊した場所で蔓延します。これは、包囲と避難によって確実にもたらされる状況です。

segments.src: Aid agencies report that damaged water systems, overcrowded displacement sites, and the collapse of routine health services have created ideal conditions for the waterborne disease to take hold.
segments.tr: 援助機関は、損傷した水システム、過密な避難場所、そして日常的な保健サービスの崩壊が、この水系感染症が定着するための理想的な条件を作り出したと報告しています。

segments.src: Sudan has recorded cholera cases in multiple states since the civil war reignited in 2023, but responders say the situation in North Kordofan is especially difficult to manage because access for aid convoys remains severely restricted, limiting the delivery of oral rehydration supplies, chlorine tablets and vaccines.
segments.tr: スーダンでは2023年に内戦が再燃して以来、複数の州でコレラ症例が記録されていますが、支援隊のアクセスが厳しく制限されており、経口補水液、塩素タブレット、ワクチンの配送が制限されているため、北コルドファン州の状況は特に管理が困難であると支援者は述べています。

segments.src: ## The UN's Warning: A Pattern That Precedes Atrocities
segments.tr: ## 国連の警告：虐殺に先立つパターン

segments.src: United Nations officials monitoring Sudan have pointed to el-Obeid as an example of a broader and deeply concerning pattern: repeated strikes on civilian infrastructure, blocked humanitarian access, and the targeting of essential services in besieged areas.
segments.tr: スーダンを監視している国連職員は、エル・オベイドを、より広範で深く懸念されるパターンの一例として挙げています。それは、民間インフラへの繰り返しの攻撃、人道支援へのアクセスの遮断、そして包囲された地域での不可欠なサービスの標的化です。

segments.src: UN representatives have cautioned that this combination of tactics — documented elsewhere in Sudan's war, including in Darfur — has historically preceded some of the gravest violations of international law, and they have urged both the Sudanese Armed Forces and the RSF to allow unimpeded humanitarian access and to protect civilians and medical facilities under international humanitarian law.
segments.tr: 国連代表者は、ダルフールを含むスーダンの戦争の他の場所で記録されたこれらの戦術の組み合わせが、歴史的に国際法の最も重大な違反のいくつかに先立っていたと警告し、スーダン軍とRSFの両方に、妨げのない人道支援アクセスを許可し、国際人道法の下で民間人と医療施設を保護することを強く求めました。

segments.src: Human rights researchers note that sieges which cut off food, water, fuel and medicine can constitute collective punishment of civilian populations, a serious violation regardless of the military objectives claimed by the parties involved.
segments.tr: 人権研究者は、食料、水、燃料、医薬品を遮断する包囲が、当事者が主張する軍事目的にかかわらず、民間人への集団的処罰となり得、重大な違反であると指摘しています。

segments.src: The UN has called for independent investigations into strikes on hospitals and for accountability mechanisms to be strengthened as the conflict continues.
segments.tr: 国連は、病院への攻撃に対する独立した調査と、紛争が続く中での責任追及メカニズムの強化を求めています。

segments.src: ## A Wider Humanitarian Emergency
segments.tr: ## より広範な人道上の緊急事態

segments.src: Sudan's civil war has already produced one of the world's largest displacement crises, with the UN estimating that millions of people have fled their homes since fighting began in April 2023.
segments.tr: スーダンの内戦は、すでに世界最大級の避難危機を引き起こしており、国連は2023年4月に戦闘が始まって以来、数百万人もの人々が家を追われたと推定しています。

segments.src: El-Obeid's situation reflects a broader trend across contested areas of the country, where famine conditions, disease outbreaks and attacks on civilian infrastructure have converged.
segments.tr: エル・オベイドの状況は、飢饉の状態、病気の流行、民間インフラへの攻撃が集中している、国内の紛争地域の広範な傾向を反映しています。

segments.src: International aid organizations have appealed for expanded humanitarian corridors and increased funding, warning that without a sustained ceasefire and guaranteed access for relief workers, cities like el-Obeid risk becoming case studies in how modern sieges can escalate into humanitarian catastrophes.
segments.tr: 国際援助団体は、人道回廊の拡大と資金提供の増額を訴え、持続的な停戦と救援活動家のための保証されたアクセスがなければ、エル・オベイドのような都市が、現代の包囲網がどのように人道上の大惨事に発展し得るかという事例研究となるリスクがある、と警告しています。

segments.src: For now, residents say they are left to weather both the drones overhead and the disease spreading in the shadows below — waiting for a diplomatic breakthrough that, so far, has remained out of reach.
segments.tr: 今のところ、住民は頭上のドローンと、その下の影で広がる病気の両方に耐えるしかないと言っています。彼らは、今のところは手の届かないところにある外交的突破口を待っています。

de.title: Vierzig Drohnen über einer Stadt: Ein Blick in die Belagerung, die die UN als Warnzeichen für Massengräueltaten bezeichnet

segments.src: ## A City Under Near-Daily Bombardment
segments.tr: ## Eine Stadt unter fast täglichen Bombardements

segments.src: For months, residents of el-Obeid, the capital of Sudan's North Kordofan state, have described a grim daily routine: the distant buzz of drones overhead, followed by the wait to see where the next strike will land.
segments.tr: Seit Monaten beschreiben die Bewohner von el-Obeid, der Hauptstadt des sudanesischen Bundesstaates Nord-Kordofan, eine düstere tägliche Routine: das ferne Summen von Drohnen über ihnen, gefolgt vom Warten darauf, wo der nächste Schlag einschlagen wird.

segments.src: Humanitarian monitors tracking the conflict say the city has absorbed dozens of drone attacks in a matter of weeks — by some counts, roughly forty strikes have hit the area — as fighting between Sudan's army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) grinds through its third year.
segments.tr: Humanitäre Beobachter, die den Konflikt verfolgen, sagen, dass die Stadt innerhalb weniger Wochen Dutzende von Drohnenangriffen ausgesetzt war — nach einigen Schätzungen trafen etwa vierzig Schläge die Region —, während die Kämpfe zwischen der sudanesischen Armee und den paramilitärischen Rapid Support Forces (RSF) in ihr drittes Jahr gehen.

segments.src: El-Obeid sits at a strategic crossroads linking Khartoum to Sudan's western regions, which is part of why it has become a flashpoint.
segments.tr: El-Obeid liegt an einem strategischen Knotenpunkt, der Khartum mit den westlichen Regionen des Sudans verbindet, was einer der Gründe ist, warum es zu einem Brennpunkt geworden ist.

segments.src: Aid workers say the city has effectively been under siege, with supply routes choked off and civilians caught between advancing front lines.
segments.tr: Hilfskräfte sagen, dass die Stadt effektiv belagert wurde, wobei die Versorgungsrouten abgeschnitten und Zivilisten zwischen vorrückenden Frontlinien gefangen sind.

segments.src: ## Hospitals Knocked Out of Service
segments.tr: ## Krankenhäuser außer Betrieb gesetzt

segments.src: Among the most alarming consequences, according to humanitarian organizations operating in the area, is the damage inflicted on el-Obeid's already-strained health system.
segments.tr: Zu den alarmierendsten Folgen gehört laut humanitären Organisationen, die in dem Gebiet tätig sind, der Schaden, der dem bereits strapazierten Gesundheitssystem von el-Obeid zugefügt wurde.

segments.src: Strikes attributed to the ongoing fighting have reportedly hit or forced the closure of medical facilities, stripping the city of capacity just as civilian casualties and disease outbreaks are rising.
segments.tr: Berichten zufolge haben Angriffe, die den laufenden Kämpfen zugeschrieben werden, medizinische Einrichtungen getroffen oder deren Schließung erzwungen, wodurch der Stadt genau dann die Kapazitäten entzogen wurden, als die zivilen Opferzahlen und Krankheitsausbrüche steigen.

segments.src: The World Health Organization and Sudanese medical unions have repeatedly warned that attacks on hospitals violate international humanitarian law, regardless of which side is responsible, and that a functioning health system is often the difference between a contained outbreak and a public health catastrophe.
segments.tr: Die Weltgesundheitsorganisation und sudanesische Ärzteverbände haben wiederholt gewarnt, dass Angriffe auf Krankenhäuser gegen das internationale humanitäre Völkerrecht verstoßen, unabhängig davon, welche Seite verantwortlich ist, und dass ein funktionierendes Gesundheitssystem oft den Unterschied zwischen einem eingedämmten Ausbruch und einer Katastrophe für die öffentliche Gesundheit ausmacht.

segments.src: With fuel, medicine and staff in short supply, doctors on the ground say they are being forced to make impossible choices about who receives treatment — a situation aid groups describe as unsustainable if the bombardment continues at its current pace.
segments.tr: Da Treibstoff, Medikamente und Personal knapp sind, sagen Ärzte vor Ort, dass sie gezwungen sind, unmögliche Entscheidungen darüber zu treffen, wer eine Behandlung erhält — eine Situation, die Hilfsgruppen als nicht tragbar beschreiben, wenn die Bombardements in ihrem derzeitigen Tempo fortgesetzt werden.

segments.src: ## Cholera Spreads as Water Systems Fail
segments.tr: ## Cholera breitet sich aus, da Wassersysteme versagen

segments.src: Compounding the crisis, health officials have confirmed a spreading cholera outbreak in and around el-Obeid.
segments.tr: Erschwerend kommt hinzu, dass Gesundheitsbehörden einen sich ausbreitenden Cholera-Ausbruch in und um el-Obeid bestätigt haben.

segments.src: Cholera thrives where clean water and sanitation infrastructure has broken down — conditions that sieges and displacement reliably produce.
segments.tr: Cholera gedeiht dort, wo sauberes Wasser und sanitäre Infrastruktur zusammengebrochen sind — Bedingungen, die Belagerungen und Vertreibungen zuverlässig hervorrufen.

segments.src: Aid agencies report that damaged water systems, overcrowded displacement sites, and the collapse of routine health services have created ideal conditions for the waterborne disease to take hold.
segments.tr: Hilfsorganisationen berichten, dass beschädigte Wassersysteme, überfüllte Vertreibungsorte und der Zusammenbruch routinemäßiger Gesundheitsdienste ideale Bedingungen für die Ansiedlung dieser wassergebundenen Krankheit geschaffen haben.

segments.src: Sudan has recorded cholera cases in multiple states since the civil war reignited in 2023, but responders say the situation in North Kordofan is especially difficult to manage because access for aid convoys remains severely restricted, limiting the delivery of oral rehydration supplies, chlorine tablets and vaccines.
segments.tr: Der Sudan hat seit dem erneuten Ausbruch des Bürgerkriegs im Jahr 2023 in mehreren Bundesstaaten Cholerafälle registriert, aber Helfer sagen, dass die Situation in Nord-Kordofan besonders schwierig zu bewältigen ist, weil der Zugang für Hilfskonvois stark eingeschränkt bleibt, was die Lieferung von oralen Rehydrationslösungen, Chlortabletten und Impfstoffen begrenzt.

segments.src: ## The UN's Warning: A Pattern That Precedes Atrocities
segments.tr: ## Die Warnung der UN: Ein Muster, das Gräueltaten vorausgeht

segments.src: United Nations officials monitoring Sudan have pointed to el-Obeid as an example of a broader and deeply concerning pattern: repeated strikes on civilian infrastructure, blocked humanitarian access, and the targeting of essential services in besieged areas.
segments.tr: Vereinte Nationen-Beamte, die den Sudan beobachten, haben el-Obeid als Beispiel für ein breiteres und zutiefst besorgniserregendes Muster hingewiesen: wiederholte Angriffe auf zivile Infrastruktur, blockierter humanitärer Zugang und das gezielte Angreifen wesentlicher Dienste in belagerten Gebieten.

segments.src: UN representatives have cautioned that this combination of tactics — documented elsewhere in Sudan's war, including in Darfur — has historically preceded some of the gravest violations of international law, and they have urged both the Sudanese Armed Forces and the RSF to allow unimpeded humanitarian access and to protect civilians and medical facilities under international humanitarian law.
segments.tr: UN-Vertreter haben gewarnt, dass diese Kombination von Taktiken — an anderen Stellen im sudanesischen Krieg dokumentiert, einschließlich Darfur — historisch einigen der schwersten Verstöße gegen das Völkerrecht vorausgegangen ist, und sie haben sowohl die sudanesischen Streitkräfte als auch die RSF aufgefordert, ungehinderten humanitären Zugang zu gewähren und Zivilisten sowie medizinische Einrichtungen gemäß dem internationalen humanitären Völkerrecht zu schützen.

segments.src: Human rights researchers note that sieges which cut off food, water, fuel and medicine can constitute collective punishment of civilian populations, a serious violation regardless of the military objectives claimed by the parties involved.
segments.tr: Menschenrechtsforscher weisen darauf hin, dass Belagerungen, die Nahrung, Wasser, Treibstoff und Medikamente abschneiden, eine kollektive Bestrafung der Zivilbevölkerung darstellen können, was einen schweren Verstoß darstellt, unabhängig von den militärischen Zielen, die von den beteiligten Parteien beansprucht werden.

segments.src: The UN has called for independent investigations into strikes on hospitals and for accountability mechanisms to be strengthened as the conflict continues.
segments.tr: Die UN hat unabhängige Untersuchungen zu den Angriffen auf Krankenhäuser gefordert und dass die Rechenschaftsmechanismen gestärkt werden, während der Konflikt andauert.

segments.src: ## A Wider Humanitarian Emergency
segments.tr: ## Ein umfassender humanitärer Notfall

segments.src: Sudan's civil war has already produced one of the world's largest displacement crises, with the UN estimating that millions of people have fled their homes since fighting began in April 2023.
segments.tr: Der Bürgerkrieg im Sudan hat bereits eine der weltweit größten Vertreibungskrisen hervorgerufen, wobei die UN schätzt, dass Millionen von Menschen seit Beginn der Kämpfe im April 2023 ihre Heimat verlassen mussten.

segments.src: El-Obeid's situation reflects a broader trend across contested areas of the country, where famine conditions, disease outbreaks and attacks on civilian infrastructure have converged.
segments.tr: Die Situation in el-Obeid spiegelt einen breiteren Trend in den umkämpften Gebieten des Landes wider, in denen Hungerbedingungen, Krankheitsausbrüche und Angriffe auf zivile Infrastruktur zusammengekommen sind.

segments.src: International aid organizations have appealed for expanded humanitarian corridors and increased funding, warning that without a sustained ceasefire and guaranteed access for relief workers, cities like el-Obeid risk becoming case studies in how modern sieges can escalate into humanitarian catastrophes.
segments.tr: Internationale Hilfsorganisationen haben appelliert, dass humanitäre Korridore erweitert und die Finanzierung erhöht wird, und gewarnt, dass ohne einen dauerhaften Waffenstillstand und garantierten Zugang für Hilfskräfte Städte wie el-Obeid Gefahr laufen, zu Fallstudien dafür zu werden, wie moderne Belagerungen in humanitäre Katastrophen ausarten können.

segments.src: For now, residents say they are left to weather both the drones overhead and the disease spreading in the shadows below — waiting for a diplomatic breakthrough that, so far, has remained out of reach.
segments.tr: Fürs Erste sagen die Bewohner, dass sie gezwungen sind, sowohl den Drohnen über ihnen als auch den sich in den Schatten ausbreitenden Krankheiten zu trotzen — und auf einen diplomatischen Durchbruch zu warten, der bisher unerreichbar geblieben ist.

segments.tr: ## Bệnh tả lây lan khi hệ thống nước bị hỏng

segments.tr: Làm trầm trọng thêm cuộc khủng hoảng, các quan chức y tế đã xác nhận một đợt bùng phát bệnh tả đang lây lan trong và xung quanh el-Obeid.

segments.tr: Bệnh tả phát triển mạnh nơi nước sạch và cơ sở hạ tầng vệ sinh bị hỏng hóc — những điều kiện mà các cuộc bao vây và sự di tản thường xuyên tạo ra.

segments.src: Aid agencies report that damaged water systems, overcrowded displacement sites, and the collapse of routine health services have created ideal conditions for the waterborne disease to take hold.
segments.tr: Các cơ quan cứu trợ báo cáo rằng hệ thống nước bị hư hỏng, các địa điểm di tản quá tải và sự sụp đổ của các dịch vụ y tế thường quy đã tạo điều kiện lý tưởng cho căn bệnh lây truyền qua đường nước này bám rễ.

segments.src: Sudan has recorded cholera cases in multiple states since the civil war reignited in 2023, but responders say the situation in North Kordofan is especially difficult to manage because access for aid convoys remains severely restricted, limiting the delivery of oral rehydration supplies, chlorine tablets and vaccines.
segments.tr: Sudan đã ghi nhận các ca bệnh tả ở nhiều bang kể từ khi cuộc nội chiến bùng nổ trở lại vào năm 2023, nhưng những người ứng phó cho biết tình hình ở North Kordofan đặc biệt khó quản lý vì quyền truy cập cho các đoàn cứu trợ vẫn bị hạn chế nghiêm trọng, hạn chế việc cung cấp vật tư tái cấp nước đường uống, viên nén clo và vắc-xin.

segments.src: ## The UN's Warning: A Pattern That Precedes Atrocities
segments.tr: ## Cảnh báo của LHQ: Một mô hình tiền đề cho các tội ác

segments.src: United Nations officials monitoring Sudan have pointed to el-Obeid as an example of a broader and deeply concerning pattern: repeated strikes on civilian infrastructure, blocked humanitarian access, and the targeting of essential services in besieged areas.
segments.tr: Các quan chức Liên Hợp Quốc giám sát Sudan đã chỉ ra el-Obeid như một ví dụ về một mô hình rộng hơn và đáng lo ngại sâu sắc: các cuộc tấn công lặp đi lặp lại vào cơ sở hạ tầng dân sự, chặn quyền truy cập nhân đạo, và nhắm mục tiêu vào các dịch vụ thiết yếu trong các khu vực bị bao vây.

segments.src: UN representatives have cautioned that this combination of tactics — documented elsewhere in Sudan's war, including in Darfur — has historically preceded some of the gravest violations of international law, and they have urged both the Sudanese Armed Forces and the RSF to allow unimpeded humanitarian access and to protect civilians and medical facilities under international humanitarian law.
segments.tr: Các đại diện LHQ đã cảnh báo rằng sự kết hợp của các chiến thuật này — được ghi nhận ở những nơi khác trong cuộc chiến ở Sudan, bao gồm cả Darfur — trong lịch sử đã tiền đề cho một số vi phạm nghiêm trọng nhất về luật quốc tế, và họ đã thúc giục cả Lực lượng Vũ trang Sudan và RSF cho phép quyền truy cập nhân đạo không bị cản trở và bảo vệ thường dân cũng như các cơ sở y tế theo luật nhân đạo quốc tế.

segments.src: Human rights researchers note that sieges which cut off food, water, fuel and medicine can constitute collective punishment of civilian populations, a serious violation regardless of the military objectives claimed by the parties involved.
segments.tr: Các nhà nghiên cứu nhân quyền lưu ý rằng các cuộc bao vây cắt đứt lương thực, nước, nhiên liệu và thuốc men có thể cấu thành hình phạt tập thể đối với dân thường, một vi phạm nghiêm trọng bất kể mục tiêu quân sự được các bên liên quan tuyên bố.

segments.src: The UN has called for independent investigations into strikes on hospitals and for accountability mechanisms to be strengthened as the conflict continues.
segments.tr: LHQ đã kêu gọi các cuộc điều tra độc lập về các cuộc tấn công vào bệnh viện và tăng cường các cơ chế trách nhiệm giải trình khi cuộc xung đột tiếp tục.

segments.src: ## A Wider Humanitarian Emergency
segments.tr: ## Một tình trạng khẩn cấp nhân đạo rộng hơn

segments.src: Sudan's civil war has already produced one of the world's largest displacement crises, with the UN estimating that millions of people have fled their homes since fighting began in April 2023.
segments.tr: Cuộc nội chiến ở Sudan đã tạo ra một trong những cuộc khủng hoảng di tản lớn nhất thế giới, với LHQ ước tính rằng hàng triệu người đã phải rời bỏ nhà cửa kể từ khi cuộc chiến bắt đầu vào tháng 4 năm 2023.

segments.src: El-Obeid's situation reflects a broader trend across contested areas of the country, where famine conditions, disease outbreaks and attacks on civilian infrastructure have converged.
segments.tr: Tình hình của el-Obeid phản ánh một xu hướng rộng hơn trên khắp các khu vực tranh chấp của đất nước, nơi các điều kiện nạn đói, sự bùng phát dịch bệnh và các cuộc tấn công vào cơ sở hạ tầng dân sự hội tụ.

segments.src: International aid organizations have appealed for expanded humanitarian corridors and increased funding, warning that without a sustained ceasefire and guaranteed access for relief workers, cities like el-Obeid risk becoming case studies in how modern sieges can escalate into humanitarian catastrophes.
segments.tr: Các tổ chức cứu trợ quốc tế đã kêu gọi mở rộng các hành lang nhân đạo và tăng cường kinh phí, cảnh báo rằng nếu không có một lệnh ngừng bắn bền vững và quyền truy cập được đảm bảo cho các nhân viên cứu trợ, các thành phố như el-Obeid có nguy cơ trở thành những bài học điển hình về cách các cuộc bao vây hiện đại có thể leo thang thành thảm họa nhân đạo.

segments.src: For now, residents say they are left to weather both the drones overhead and the disease spreading in the shadows below — waiting for a diplomatic breakthrough that, so far, has remained out of reach.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, cư dân cho biết họ bị bỏ mặc để chống chọi với cả những chiếc flycam trên cao và căn bệnh đang lây lan trong bóng tối bên dưới — chờ đợi một bước đột phá ngoại giao mà cho đến nay vẫn nằm ngoài tầm với.
